senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) warp; trnsf. longitudinal direction, v. עֵרֶב.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:2:3">Y. Shek. VI, 50ᵃ</cite> top <he>כחוט של ש׳</he> as thin as a thread of the warp.
Mikv. VI, 9 כותל … שנסדק לש׳ a wall … which is cracked lengthwise; a. fr.—ש׳ וערב crosswise, v. עֵרֶב.
